decisions.decision: Chair directed the superintendent to remove a school committee member's message that had been posted using district communication resources and to reinforce the policy against individual members using district channels.
Mr. Beardmore and Mr. Scolbrini agreed to meet with the superintendent about the track and field program before the next night's finance committee meeting.
Rather than fully cutting a Turkey Hill special education inclusion teacher and an MTSS teacher, the district will cut half of each position and combine coach support to cover both functions.
The committee accepted that the athletic transportation line could not be reduced as previously discussed, given updated cost data.
The proposal to restructure the curriculum office/coaching positions was set aside for a fuller written analysis rather than acted on that night.
Since no consensus on cuts was reached, the superintendent will present the town manager's version of the budget to the finance committee the next night as the working baseline.
Committee members will submit a prioritized list of what to restore first if additional funds (e.g., more Chapter 70 aid) become available.
An additional joint School Committee/select board-related budget and override discussion meeting was set for the following Wednesday (March 12).

minutes.headline: Committee cut the athletic secretary but tabled the whole FY26 budget after huge pushback on athletics and staff cuts
minutes.summary: This was a lengthy FY26 budget meeting dominated by extensive public and student testimony opposing proposed cuts to athletics, activity fees, AP/honors courses, and teaching and support staff. The committee voted to cut the part-time athletic secretary, rejected proposed cuts to head coaches and to the Director of Finance and Administration position, tabled a bus fee proposal for further work, and ultimately tabled the full FY26 recommended budget without adopting a final version, planning to present the town manager's baseline budget to the finance committee and to hold a further joint meeting on the budget and a possible override.

what_happened.line: The committee tabled the full FY26 budget without adopting a version, sending the town manager's baseline to the finance committee instead.
Members cut the part-time athletic secretary position by a unanimous vote.
A motion to cut head coaching positions failed, as did a motion to convert the Director of Finance and Administration role to save money.
A proposed daily bus fee was tabled 3-2 for further work rather than adopted or rejected outright.
A further joint School Committee/Select Board meeting on the budget and a possible override was set for the following week.

why_it_matters: No FY26 school budget has been adopted yet, and the version now headed to the finance committee is the town manager's, not the committee's own — residents will hear more before anything is final.
The meeting turned on athletics, activity fees, and staff cuts, following extensive public and student testimony against them; only the athletic secretary position was cut so far.
A town override is now openly part of the discussion, which would mean asking voters to raise taxes above the state levy cap to fund the budget.
